annotations.title: Check business arithmetic to the cent

description: 1 call. Recomputes a business calculation exactly (decimal, stated rounding) and says whether a claimed result is correct: invoice/claim totals with discounts and shipping, GST/VAT invoices, loan interest and amortisation, depreciation, FX with markup and fees, FIFO / moving-average inventory, weekly payroll overtime, trade quotes. Input fields per kind are listed by the coverage tool.

claimed_result.description: Optional: the single number to check, e.g. 49.32.

claimed_results.description: Optional: several named numbers to check, e.g. {"interest": 49.32, "total": 10049.32}.

inputs.description: The numbers, e.g. loan_interest {principal, annual_rate_percent, days, day_count 365|360}; invoice_or_claim_total {lines[{quantity, unit_price, discount_percent?}], invoice_discount_percent?, shipping?, tax_rate_percent?, tax_on_shipping?, amount_paid?}. Full field list per kind: coverage.

name: verify_calculation
title: Check business arithmetic to the cent
